priorIterationResolution.priorFinding: FIND-005 (iteration-4, sidecar count-vs-set ambiguity risking null post_url)
priorIterationResolution.note: REQ-008(3) REV5 now explicitly says 'THE SIDECAR SHALL RECORD A SET, NOT A COUNT' and stores the exact stabilized before['hrefs'] array as JSON at `~/clips/pending-verify/<clipname>.before-hrefs.json`. The self-heal driver computes a real set difference `new_hrefs = stabilized_reels_set - set(sidecar_hrefs)`, uses `new_hrefs[0]` (the actual href string, not an index-0 guess against a raw scrape) only when exactly one element is present, and treats 0-new or >1-new as inconclusive (leave in pending-verify/, never fabricate a post_url, never guess). REQ-009 step 1 now has an explicit 'non-null non-empty post_url' guard, textually matching step 2's existing guard. PROP-006 was re-read and now asserts the exact non-null post_url string (not just 'a ledger line exists'), and PROP-007 adds a dedicated regression case for a status:posted line with post_url:null being excluded from the count. Both halves of iteration-4's finding are resolved.

priorIterationResolution.priorFinding: FIND-006 (iteration-4, no test coverage for the null-post_url regression)
priorIterationResolution.note: PROP-006 (verification-architecture.md line 74) explicitly labels its 3-href-stub assertion 'this is the concrete regression test for FIND-005/006' and asserts the exact URL string. PROP-007 (line 75) adds a second, explicitly-labeled 'NEW regression test for FIND-005/006': a status:posted line with post_url:null mixed with a valid line must count as 1, not 2. Both are concrete, assertable test cases, not vague coverage claims.
